question: How many vacation days do new employees get per year?
reference_answer: Full-time employees accrue 15 days of paid vacation per calendar year during their first three years of employment.

question: Can unused vacation days be carried over to the next year?
reference_answer: Yes, employees may carry over up to 10 unused vacation days into the following year; anything beyond that is forfeited on December 31st.

question: How many days per week can an employee work remotely without special approval?
reference_answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval; fully remote arrangements need Director-level sign-off.

question: What is the daily meal reimbursement limit for business travel?
reference_answer: Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to $75 per day.

question: When do formal performance reviews happen?
reference_answer: Formal performance reviews occur twice yearly, in June and December.

question: What is the maximum flight time of the Nimbus-4 drone?
reference_answer: Maximum flight time is 90 minutes on a full battery charge under standard conditions.

question: What wind speed triggers the Nimbus-4's automatic return-to-home procedure?
reference_answer: Gusts above 50 km/h will trigger an automatic return-to-home procedure.

question: How long does it take to fully charge the Nimbus-4's battery?
reference_answer: A full charge from empty takes approximately 75 minutes using the included fast charger.

question: Does the Nimbus-4 require a remote ID broadcast module?
reference_answer: It does not require a remote ID broadcast module in jurisdictions where it is flown within visual line of sight and below 120 meters, though the module is available as an optional add-on.

question: How long is the warranty on the Nimbus-4's battery pack?
reference_answer: The battery pack carries a separate 6-month warranty, distinct from the 2-year warranty on the airframe and electronics.
